topic:
Architecture, conventions & token library for a designer-editable coded design system for apps/pi-remote-web.

Goal: Decide, with cited evidence, (1) the component architecture and file/setup conventions, (2) the designer-editability model — token-first CSS, an inline-comment grammar labelling each editable region and per-state block, variant/slot conventions, 'edit here' seams, and guardrails keeping logic and the security boundary out of a designer's edit path, and (3) the token-library architecture — primitive -> semantic -> component layering with the frozen ink-on-parchment palette as the primitive source, the light/dark theming mechanism, and WCAG AA contrast guaranteed at the token layer.

Reference direction (investigate, do not assume): the Untitled UI React library, shadcn/ui, Radix Themes, Material 3 tokens, Polaris token tiers.
